Original Decipher card face for [[Tatooine: Podrace Arena]], rotated losslessly from the archive scan [[:File:Tat-L-tatooinepodracearena-decipher-archive.jpg]] so the location reads landscape.

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/tatooinepodracearenaL.jpg tatooinepodracearenaL.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010809060101/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/tatooinepodracearenaL.jpg Internet Archive], 9 August 2001. SHA-256 of the archived file: f11229a1c132d1157029e107ba6fd91a5af171db20c7fbf5236e53b1326dbd70.

Edits: rotated losslessly from the archive scan (jpegtran -trim -rotate 90 -copy all; JPEG data rotated without recompression). jpegtran drops the partial 8-pixel block at one edge (4 pixel rows of black border); no other change.

The Holotable face [[:File:Tat-L-tatooinepodracearena.gif]] is a separate file and is not replaced by this file.
